text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I should've found the place by now, but
there are
no restaurants around. I don't
even see any
people.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime, but no one's serving any
food. Do
they only have food trucks
around here or
something?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe the locals just know where all
the
restaurants are and are gathered
there?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you like takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. I should have given you some
context.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Y'know how I'm gonna be running in the
Twinkle
Series, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well, I thought it'd be nice to do
something to lift
the mood before my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then Tama suggested a tasty takoyaki
place in
town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Oguri Cap has come up with her
own
unique way of working toward her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"They're round and chewy! And they're
the
perfect snack to get a boost..."
apparently.
choice_data_list: けど、どうしてたこ焼きなんだ？
けど、どうしてたこ焼きなの？

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama made sure to drum the location
into me, so
you can relax. I'll take care
of everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us head out together, and in
spite of
Oguri Cap's enthusiasm, I can't
help but worry in
the back of my mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Oh no. Am I really lost again?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, impossible... I made sure to
double-check
everything with Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna repeat it one last time, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Once you're outta the station, ya gotta
stroll
down the main street, then turn
when ya get to
Mile Supermarket.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ya get confused, jus' look for the car
park.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Simple, right? Don't forget! The car
park!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't find the landmark she
mentioned... I've
been looking and
looking, and... well, here we
are.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A car park... Where in the world could
that be? I
haven't seen any parks at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There seems to have been a
miscommunication
between Oguri Cap
and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait... Do you think she meant a parking lot?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By "car park," Tamamo Cross was
actually
referring to a parking lot.
Apparently, that's what
they call them
where she's from.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Now that I think about it, we did
walk past a
big parking lot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We should probably start by going back
there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But wait... How are we gonna find our
way back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My stomach started growling because I
was
thinking about the takoyaki...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Is this where it all ends?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But the folks back home... I still haven't
done
them proud!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is this where my dream to run in the
central races
dies?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh! That would great...
choice_data_list: 今日は近場の店を探そう

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry for always being so useless.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for sure. I won't get lost a second
time!
choice_data_list: たこ焼きはまた今度行こう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's eyes quietly burn with
determination.
As long as she keeps this
spirit up, making her
debut will be a
cinch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Takoyaki... So round and chewy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...This is but the beginning of Oguri
Cap's epic
tale.
